candidates.researchQuestion: How should long-lived digital employees preserve pending work across interruption and restart without turning persistence itself into permission to execute?
candidates.title: Durable Work Is Not Execution Authority
candidates.title_zh: 持久工作不等于执行权

sections.heading: Three facts that should not collapse into one
sections.heading_zh: 三个事实不能合并成一个事实

sections.heading: Engineering implication: model authority explicitly
sections.heading_zh: 工程含义：把权威显式建模

evidenceClaims.claim: The selected implementation persists queued submissions per thread with stable work identity.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所选实现按 Thread 持久化 Queue Submission，并保留稳定的工作身份。

evidenceClaims.claim: A persisted queue item is removed only after the core admits execution as started.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 持久化 Queue Item 只有在 Core 接纳执行并返回 Started 后才会删除。

evidenceClaims.claim: Durable work identity, execution admission and resumption authorization should remain separate control facts.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 持久工作身份、执行准入与恢复授权应保持为不同的控制事实。

projectRelevance.rationale: The engineering argument is complete without first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the transferable engineering question.

candidates.researchQuestion: What must be added to a multi-layer accountable-AI architecture before it can function as an operational governance system rather than remain a conceptual framework or dashboard?
candidates.title: From KPI Visibility to Decision Rights: Making AI Operations Governable
candidates.title_zh: 从 KPI 可见性到决策权：让 AI 运营真正可治理

sections.heading: A dashboard can observe without governing
sections.heading_zh: 仪表盘可以观察，却未必能够治理

sections.heading: Governed KPIs need a control contract
sections.heading_zh: 受治理 KPI 需要一份控制契约

evidenceClaims.claim: The published artefact describes a three-stage airline operating architecture across six capability layers.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已发布成果描述了一个跨六个 Capability Layer 的三阶段航空运营架构。

evidenceClaims.claim: The paper proposes binding governed KPIs to owners, thresholds, escalation paths, decision cadence and corrective action.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 论文提出把受治理 KPI 绑定到 Owner、Threshold、Escalation Path、Decision Cadence 与 Corrective Action。

evidenceClaims.claim: Governance begins when measured state is bound to decision authority and a closed corrective-action loop.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 当测量状态与决策权以及闭合的纠正行动回路绑定时，治理才真正开始。

projectRelevance.rationale: The architecture analysis is complete without first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: No separate community framing adds enough value beyond the complete Research Center analysis.

candidates.researchQuestion: What recovery guarantees does prompt-scoped cancellation rollback actually provide, and what additional mechanisms are required before an aborted agent request can be safely retried after external tool side effects?
candidates.title: Cancellation Rollback Stops at the Local State Boundary
candidates.title_zh: 取消回滚止于本地状态边界

sections.heading: A logical request can be rolled back locally
sections.heading_zh: 一个逻辑请求可以在本地整体回退

sections.heading: Engineering implication: retry is an admission decision
sections.heading_zh: 工程含义：重试本身是一项准入决定

evidenceClaims.claim: The selected change records one rollback baseline across continuation calls that share a prompt identity.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所选变更会在共享 Prompt Identity 的 Continuation Call 之间记录同一个回滚基线。

evidenceClaims.claim: Recognized cancellation restores local history and token accounting but does not reverse external tool effects.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 识别到 Cancellation 后可以恢复本地 History 与 Token Accounting，但不能撤销外部工具副作用。

evidenceClaims.claim: Safe cancellation recovery should separate local rollback, external-effect reconciliation and retry admission.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 安全的 Cancellation Recovery 应区分本地回滚、外部副作用核对与重试准入。

projectRelevance.rationale: The cancellation boundary is a general engineering question and needs no first-party project insertion.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already preserves the necessary mechanism and evidence boundaries.
